question: What is the effect of merely hearing this knowledge, as addressed to the fair-faced one?
premises: The knowledge is described as merely heard.
The instrument is this knowledge alone.
The statement is addressed to the fair-faced one.
inference: Therefore even mere hearing of this knowledge is presented as efficacious.
uncertainties: The main predicate continues in the next verse.
plain_english: O fair-faced one, by this mere knowledge, simply heard...
